description: Station de réparation vélo - Anglet is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Anglet. Dataset of bike repair stations in Anglet. At each station, everyone can freely dispose, 24 hours a day, of ergonomic equipment with tools most useful to cyclists, including a bicycle pump, flat keys, tire disassembly, Key Torx T25, flat and cruciform screwdriver, set of Allen keys and a support to raise the bike during repair. Coverage: Ville d'Anglet. The portal shows the English title as "Bike Repair Station – Anglet" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Anglet. Its keywords include urbanisme-equipement, station-reparation-velo, borne-reparation, mobilite-espace-public. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2024-01-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
